item.description: Editorial Cartoonist John Dunn gives a sneak peek into the stands at the Beanpot Final.

item.title: International Tankers Have Become the Pawns in the Chess Match Between World Powers
item.description: Warfare extends far beyond the battlefield and can incorporate tactics that are unconventional to the average soldier. In these turbulent times, rising and established powers are precariously pushing the limits of confrontation.

item.title: Avoidantly in Love
item.description: As someone who grew up naively believing that romance would unexpectedly stumble into my life, it’s hard not to harbor a little resentment as I walk past store windows filled with roses and weave through couples holding hands come February.

item.title: BC Back to Basking in Beanpot Glory With 6–2 Win Over BU
item.description: No. 14 Boston College men's hockey's offense answered the call under the brightest of lights, bringing Beanpot glory back to BC after a decade with a 6–2 win over BU in the 300th edition of the Battle of Comm. Ave.

item.title: Hey, What’s 10 Years?
item.description: After 10 long years, the Beanpot is finally back in Chestnut Hill. Sports Editor Maria Stefanoudakis looks back on the feelings that came with 10 years without a title—and what it could mean for the Eagles' 2026 season.

item.title: An Ode to Love and Latin America: Bad Bunny’s Super Bowl LX Halftime Show
item.description: His performance was a love letter to Latinos and every marginalized person who has been made to feel small.

item.title: UGBC Explores Flat-Rate Textbook Program and Academic Advising Match Form
item.description: A UGBC-backed program to replace individual textbook purchases with a flat-rate fee will be considered by University officials in the coming days, according to Senate discussions Tuesday night.

item.title: Mayor Laredo Signs Executive Order Limiting Newton’s Cooperation With Federal Immigration Enforcement
item.description: In his first executive act, Newton Mayor Marc Laredo signed an order on Feb. 5 limiting local government cooperation with federal enforcement, joining the effort of Boston Mayor Michelle Wu and other leaders from communities across Greater Boston.
